name: Mail
beschreibung: Letters, notices and receipts from the file store and the phone: read, filed, due dates found.

rechte.beschreibung: May search and read incoming letters, except confidential ones, and sees the due dates.
May also read confidential letters: tax, salary, health, court and attorney.
May fetch the data of invoices and receipts for the bookkeeping.
May check whether the scanner's file stores and the text recognition work, and start fetching. Sees no letters doing so.

funktionen.name: search_documents
funktionen.beschreibung: Searches the incoming mail (without confidential letters) by words, kind and period.

query.description: Words found in the sender, subject, file number or text

kind.description: letter, notice, invoice, reminder, contract, court, attorney, advertising or other

funktionen.name: read_document
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows a letter with its full text, its due dates and the other letters of the same case.

funktionen.name: search_confidential_documents
funktionen.beschreibung: Searches all mail, confidential letters included.

query.description: Words found in the sender, subject, file number or text

kind.description: letter, notice, invoice, reminder, contract, court, attorney, advertising or other

funktionen.name: read_confidential_document
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows a letter, a confidential one too, with full text and due dates.

funktionen.name: document_file
funktionen.beschreibung: Fetches a letter's original file (the scan or the photo) into your work folder under werkzeuge/…, for example as a mail attachment. Not confidential letters.

funktionen.name: confidential_document_file
funktionen.beschreibung: Fetches a letter's original file, a confidential one too, into your work folder under werkzeuge/….

funktionen.name: due_dates
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows every due date and appointment from the mail in a period (without one: today and the next 10 days). Confidential ones only with kind and date.

funktionen.name: receipt_data
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows the data of a receipt: sender, date, number, amount, IBAN, payment reference.

funktionen.name: sources_status
funktionen.beschreibung: Checks every file store (the scanner folder) with a quick look inside, and the text recognition: what is missing, what fails, how many pages were read this month.

funktionen.name: sync_now
funktionen.beschreibung: Fetches the mail from every file store now, in the background. Afterwards sources_status shows whether it worked.

ereignisse.beschreibung: An invoice, payment reminder or notice requests a payment.
A notice or letter one can object to within a period.
A letter sets a date that must be kept.
A letter names a date (due date, advance payment, appointment) with nothing else to do. Only days still ahead.

ereignisse.titel: Mail from a court or attorney
ereignisse.beschreibung: Always confidential and always for the owner, never passed on to anyone else.
Something about a letter is unclear, usually a due date or a receipt's amount. A person has to look.
An invoice or receipt for the bookkeeping, with sender, date and amount.

einstellungen.name: DMS_INTERVAL_MIN
einstellungen.titel: Check the file stores every … minutes
einstellungen.beschreibung: How often Mail looks into the scanner folders and other file stores for new letters. 0 = only on request.

einstellungen.name: DMS_ARCHIVE_DAYS
einstellungen.titel: Only file old letters from … days
einstellungen.beschreibung: On a file store's first fetch: a letter dated more than this many days back is filed but not announced. 0 = every letter is announced.
